title: Individual hunger strike beginning 15 November in Kamppi
exclusion_reason: Organizer press release describes one named organizer starting a hunger strike at Kampintori. This is an individual action, not evidence of a gathering of 50 or more; do not merge it with the 18 November ministry demonstration.

date.summary: Press release states it began on 15 November 2020.

participants.summary: The accessible organizer account names one person beginning the fast; no mass gathering is described.
